name: Brian M. Hoffstadt
office: Presiding Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Five

items.text: Brian M. Hoffstadt is the Presiding Justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Five, serving on the appellate court since 2014. He was a Los Angeles Superior Court judge from 2010 to 2014. Before that, he was a Jones Day partner and an assistant U.S. attorney. In 2022, he wrote a unanimous opinion upholding the dismissal of a wrongful-death lawsuit against a film producer.
